## Problem Statement

What problem are you solving? What pain or gap exists today?

## Proposed Solution

What do you want to add or change? Keep it concrete and minimal.

## Alternatives Considered

What other approaches did you weigh, and why did you reject them?

## Out of Scope

Anything you deliberately do not want this change to touch.

## Acceptance Criteria

A short checklist of what "done" looks like.
